description: A prominent north–south–oriented linear ridge approximately 3–5 m wide and at least 2 km long, showing up as a subtle elevation high in the hillshade and corresponding to a low-reflectance line in NIR suggestive of an engineered canal or causeway.

An east–west linear feature roughly 2–3 m wide, intersecting anomaly_1 at right angles near –9.1490 lat; appears as a rectilinear channel or ditch in the slope/curvature derivatives and shows corresponding vegetation stress in the visual bands.

A meandering, curved channel segment in the southern third of the scene, ~500 m long and 2–4 m wide, visible as a positive relief arc in the hillshade and as a brighter line in the NIR image indicating wetter soils.
